lampDiagnostic.warning: Earlier exploratory profile used per-lamp timers. Its timings are excluded; only call counts and matching state fingerprints are retained. Final counts use increments without per-call timers. lampChecks counts isOn calls, not all candidate distance tests.

populationMetrics.version1: Recorded livingInfected/peakInfected fields are director slot counts, including recoverable downed actors under strict L8 admission. They are not actual alive actor counts.
populationMetrics.derivedLivingInfectedActors: Exactly the number of health-positive active infected: the original humanQueryChecks loop visits each such actor once. Present for final/hold; unavailable in older baseline captures.
populationMetrics.version2: Updated producer separates actual livingInfected/peakInfected from directorSlots.
